title: Compact micro-token system: micro-type scale, subpixel shadow layering, and corner micro-radius
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Context:
This ticket introduces a micro-token system targeted at dense lists, table rows, and compact controls (eg. inline chips, condensed toolbars) where current token stepping creates visual noise or forces awkward spacing. The design aims to provide a coherent set for color, type, spacing/radius, and shadows tuned for sub-16px UI and high-density dashboards.

Scope:
- Define a 7-step micro typography scale (12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20 with tuned line-heights)
- Add an 11-step micro-radius scale with 2px increments including a 0.5px 'hairline' option for focused micro components
- Introduce a layered shadow system: ambient (soft, large spread) + direct (tight, subpixel offsets) with half-pixel steps for the direct layer
- Create contrast-adjusted palette aliases for on-surface and subtle borders in compact mode
- Provide migration tokens and automated codemods for Button/Table/Chart components
- Include accessibility targets: AA for text >= 13px, WCAG checks for semantic components

Constraints & Trade-offs:
- Subpixel shadow values rely on modern rendering; older browsers may rasterize differently — fallback tokens included
- Tight typography steps risk truncation; we must coordinate with dev truncation logic and ellipsising
- Must avoid inflating bundle size: token aliases should map to existing variables where possible
acceptance_criteria:
1) Token spec published in Figma + tokens JSON exported and reviewed by design/eng
2) Prototype for Table row at 12px and 13px validated across chrome/safari/firefox with no layout regressions
3) Button component variants (primary/secondary/icon-only) converted to micro tokens and passes visual regression tests
4) Migration codemod created for Tables and Buttons with test run on at least 2 consumer repos
5) Accessibility checklist completed and signed off by accessibility lead
migration_notes:
- Phase 1: Add micro-token aliases (no breaking rename). Update Console to import aliases.
- Phase 2: Ship codemod to replace hardcoded spacing/radius values in Dashboard and DataGrid repos.
- Phase 3: Deprecate legacy compact tokens after 2 release cycles and update docs.
- Rollback: aliases map back to current core tokens if issues found
rollout_plan:
Week 1: Spec and Figma + internal design review (this ticket)
Week 2: Dev implementation of token JSON and shadow utils; create codemod
Week 3: Apply codemod on dashboard-beta and run visual diffs; fix layout edge-cases
Week 4: Release behind feature flag; monitor Console metrics for layout regressions and customer support tickets
Post-release: Deprecation announcement and migration guide
